title: workload.deployment.promote v1 request data
description: Durable request to promote a workload to a revision. At-least-once on PF_WORK, so the handler MUST be idempotent on the envelope `(source, id)`. The outcome comes back as workload.deployment.promoted.v1 carrying this request's `correlationid`, never as a reply. Evolved additively within v1: new OPTIONAL fields only. A new required field, a removed field or a retyped field is a v2.

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace the object lives in.

toRevision.description: Git revision (full SHA) the desired state came from.

fromRevision.description: Revision the requester believes the workload is on. When present the handler MUST refuse the promote if the live revision differs — an optimistic-concurrency guard against two promotes racing.

strategy.description: Promotion strategy. Absent means the workload's configured default.

requestedBy.description: Principal id that asked for the promote. Audit trail for an action that changes running state.
